description: Implementation of New Health Sector Project Proposals to enhance the health condition of the people
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Due to the economic crisis that affected the country during the period 2021-2024 owing to the COVID-19 pandemic, many healthcare projects have been temporarily suspended. With the recent improvement in the economy, the need to re-commence the suspended projects as well as to initiate new projects aimed at improving the healthcare status of the people has been identified. Accordingly, in pursuant to the Budget call for the year 2026, the Public Investment Committee has selected a number of new projects in the health sector for inclusion in the Public Investment Programme, giving priority to the implementation of the currently implemented projects and new initiatives included in the Public Investment Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the following 09 new projects, for which provisions will be made through the Budget Estimates 2026, in the ensuing year, was approved by the Cabinet.

National Oral Health Survey - 2025/2026.
Extension of the existing four-storied building for establishment of the proposed Operating Theatre, Endoscopy Unit and Cardio-Thoracic Pre-op Wards in the Teaching Hospital Kurunegala.
Construction of a five-storied building for Surgical and Maternity Care with Radiology facilities at the Matale District Hospital.
Construction of a five- storied building with OPD and Specialized Units at the Institute of Oral Health (IOH), Maharagama.
Construction of a five- storied building for the Institute of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology (JMO Office - Colombo).
Construction of Phase I and Phase II of the Accident and Emergency Treatment and Related Services Building Complex at the Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura.
Construction of Consultants’ and Medical Officers’ Quarters at the Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura.
Extension of Radiology Unit at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa.
Construction of the National Heart Center at the National Hospital, Sri Lanka.
